d: Prime Student Services is a specialized student services agency based in Kuwait, supporting learners who plan to study abroad. Since 2017, the organization has provided professional guidance for applications to universities and certified English language institutions worldwide. With over 300 agreements with highly ranked academic institutions across different study levels, Prime helps students from diverse nationalities obtain academic offers that align with their ambitions. The agency also assists with student visa procedures and arranges suitable transportation and housing options, aiming to ensure a smooth transition to international study environments.

Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Graphic Designer role based in Kuwait. The Graphic Designer will create visual assets for digital and print materials, including marketing campaigns, social media content, presentations, and student-facing collateral. Responsibilities include designing logos and brand elements, developing cohesive visual identities, selecting and refining typography, and preparing production-ready files. The role also involves collaborating with marketing and student services teams to translate concepts into clear, engaging graphics that support outreach, recruitment, and informational materials. The Graphic Designer will manage multiple projects, adhere to timelines, and ensure all designs align with Prime Student Services’ brand guidelines.
q: -Design social media posts, carousels, stories, and paid ad creatives for Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook.
-Create digital and print materials for education fairs, school visits, and university events.
-Contribute content ideas and develop visual concepts from campaign briefs.
-Edit short-form videos for Reels, TikTok, and paid campaigns, including cuts, captions, and simple motion graphics.
-Adapt designs for different platforms and formats while maintaining consistent branding and checking details before publication..
A portfolio that demonstrates strong layout, typography, and visual storytelling, with examples of social media or campaign design.
Proficiency in graphic design tools such as Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator, or equivalent software.
Knowledge of social media content creation, including how to adapt ideas and formats for different platforms and audiences.
Practical video editing skills using Premiere Pro, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, or an equivalent tool.
Attention to detail and the ability to manage deadlines and incorporate feedback.

d: AHS is a Dubai-based group focused on ultra-luxury real estate development, strategic investments, and high-value ventures. With a portfolio centered on high-value assets and complex operations, the business takes a detail-driven approach to financial stewardship, planning, and performance.

Within this environment, the maritime side of the business requires rigorous financial oversight, clear reporting, and close coordination across operational teams to support smooth day-to-day management.

As Yacht Accountant, you will play a key role in supporting the financial control and planning behind yacht operations. This role is suited to someone who is comfortable working across detailed accounting activity and broader financial coordination, helping ensure accuracy, visibility, and informed decision-making across yacht-related operations.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a closely related field.
At least five years of accounting experience in yacht or luxury asset accounting.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, with experience using Zoho and Microsoft 365.
Strong knowledge of maritime financial practices, tax regulations, and reporting requirements.
r: Maintain accurate financial records for yacht operating, maintenance, and crew expenses.
Prepare monthly financial statements, budgets, forecasts, and variance analyses.
Manage accounts payable and receivable, invoicing, and timely vendor payments.
Coordinate with yacht management teams to support financial and operational planning.
